summary: Mobile ATHM-1 full-depth parity smoke on Expo web preview: login (cathy@example.com) → /athm projects list → create project inline form → project detail → advance-stage → AT item add → start-trial (countdown card) → HM modification add → 2 quotes side-by-side with cheapest/dearest highlighting and HIGH VARIANCE 60% flag → OT referrals section (upload button renders; picker not automatable). All six requested flows PASS. Mobile detail matches web /athm behavior described in the review.
critical_code_review_comments: advance() in /app/mobile/app/athm-project/[id].tsx uses Math.min(idx + 1, STATUS_STEPS.length - 3) which caps advancement at 'in_use' (index len-3) — good, but silently no-ops at the cap without user feedback. Consider surfacing a toast or hiding the button once the cap is reached (web parity check recommended).
In refreshAll(), items and modifications are fetched with Promise.all of individual GETs (one per id). Fine for small projects but O(n) round-trips; consider a batched endpoint if lists grow.

uploadReferral() swallows all errors silently (catch { /* ignore */ }). If the /documents upload or attach fails, the user gets no feedback. Same pattern in addItem/addMod/startTrial/detachReferral. Consider surfacing errors like AthmProjects.jsx does on the web.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 ATHM project ('TEST Bathroom safety upgrade'), 1 AT item ('TEST Walking Frame') with active 14-day trial, 1 HM modification ('Walk-in shower') with 2 quotes ($5k, $8k) under Cathy → Mum participant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /athm route requires a signed-in caregiver with an active participant (uses ParticipantContext active id). Cathy defaults to 'Mum' as active. To reach the project detail, tap a card at /athm, which routes to /athm-project/[id]. All key testIDs verified working: athm-projects-root, athm-new-project, athm-new-project-form, athm-project-type, athm-project-title, athm-project-need, athm-project-save, athm-project-card-<id>, athm-project-detail-<id>, athm-advance-<id>, athm-add-item-toggle-<id>, athm-item-category/name/save, athm-item-<id>, athm-item-trial-days-<id>, athm-item-start-trial-<id>, trial-countdown-<id>, athm-add-mod-toggle-<id>, athm-mod-category/name/location/save, mod-quote-block-<mid>, mod-add-supplier/amount/quote-<mid>, mod-quote-row-<mid>-N, athm-ot-referrals-<id>, athm-ot-referral-upload-<id>. Note: RN Pressable buttons don't render as <button>, so use get_by_text or data-testid for Sign In. expo-document-picker cannot be exercised on the web preview.
